comment: With Inked Pen at radius 1, a 2 px dab in pixel mode, 9 of 59 door strokes given as two equal points left the target texel as it was, and the door answered OK. At zoom 0.61 and then at zoom 1, 200 integer points are each stroked as two equal points by the tool route in document pixels, and one texel step reads every target and its eight neighbours, nine to a point. Every target holds paint and no neighbour does, and every stroke's line names the target as the texel of its one dab. The points stand 5 to 12 texels apart, so no two rings touch.
